hooks.command: f="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.py) command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff check --quiet "$f" || true;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" in *specs/*.yaml|*specs/*.yml) grep -q 'citation:' "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" || echo 'HOOK: spec file has no citation: field. Every threshold cites its source (SPECIFICATION.md 4).' ;; esac
